Section 7.2(c) permits Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by Section 7.3(g), gated on the Parent Borrower's pro forma compliance with the financial covenants in Section 7.1. This is a REFERENCED permission: the underlying permission for the underlying Indebtedness and its Liens sits in Section 7.3(g) (an independently operative permission modeled by reference as a REQUIRES dependency), and the compliance gate depends on the Section 7.1 financial covenant tests (themselves separately operative obligations) — both carried as explicit dependsOn so they are preserved as cross-unit dependencies rather than guessed or dropped.

The capacity is UNLIMITED_CAPACITY gated by a boolean compliance condition: the provision imposes no dollar ceiling and only a pro forma compliance test, so representing it as a fabricated dollar amount would be dangerous; the UNLIMITED_CAPACITY form with a gatedBy boolean of pro forma compliance with Section 7.1 is the faithful shape.

Sufficiency is PARTIAL: the core permission and its pro forma compliance gate are faithfully represented, but the underlying Section 7.1 financial covenant tests (Senior Secured Leverage <= 3.75:1, Total Leverage <= 5.50:1, Interest Coverage >= 2.75:1, Liquidity test, each with Material Acquisition step-up and Early Maturing Debt mechanics) are themselves separately operative covenants in another section and are carried here only as an explicit REQUIRES dependency, not expanded into this rule.

The AMENDMENT_LEAD (CONMED Second Amendment 2022-08-01) references amending the 'Indebtedness' definition with a '$100,000,000' proviso, but its operative status is OPERATIVE_STATE_UNRESOLVED (NOT CONFIRMED CURRENT); per policy it must be treated as non-authoritative, and it does not affect the §7.2(c) operative text which is confirmed CURRENT. The Section 7.3(g) and Section 7.1 nodes carry UNKNOWN_SUPERSESSION_STATUS in the deterministic harness retrieval but their in-context region excerpts are marked evidenceStatus CURRENT for the regions relevant to this rule.
